verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a conversation-context page covering 'every lever the API gives you for managing that context', with call-time levers such as a mid-call InjectAgentMessage. Each WebSocket session is configured through a Settings message, which suggests context can be supplied per call. However, no evidence shows a dynamic-variable or templating mechanism, or an explicit way to inject per-caller data into the prompt at call start. InjectAgentMessage only makes the agent speak a line, which is adjacent to injecting context. Missing for 10: documented dynamic variable/template substitution, explicit per-caller context injection at session start, worked personalization examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized

citations.quote: This page covers every lever the API gives you for managing that context.
